channel.title: AI Survival Guide
channel.description: The definitive guide to AI disruption, data center energy demands, and survival resources. Plain-English breakdowns for everyone.

item.title: The AI Takeover: Is Your Sector Next?
item.description: Millions of jobs. Billions of gallons of water. Entire power grids on the edge. This is what's actually happening with AI — and what you need to understand before it's too late.

item.title: Decoding the Jargon: LLMs, Neural Networks, and Generative AI Explained
item.description: Plain-English definitions of the technical terms the AI industry uses to obscure what's really happening. LLMs, neural networks, parameters, GPU clusters — explained without a CS degree.

item.title: The Grid Monsters: Data Centers, Water Usage, and the Energy Crisis Nobody Talks About
item.description: AI data centers already consume 2% of global electricity and use billions of litres of water per day. By 2027, they will consume more electricity than the entire country of Japan.
